// INT-RAWCONST-HAVOC-1: the edition-2024 safe-FFI write through `&raw const x`.
unsafe extern "C" {
    safe fn memset(s: *mut u8, c: i32, n: usize) -> *mut u8;
}
pub fn ffi_const(k: u8) -> u8 {
    let mut x: u8 = 5;
    let p = &raw const x;
    // SAFETY: p points to x, which is live and mutable.
    memset(p as *mut u8, k as i32, 1);
    x + 1
}
